### 4.1 Amalgamation and Subdivision

Objectives


### 4

### DETAILED DESIGN

### GUIDELINES

Controls

#### Amalgamation and Subdivision

#### Objectives

(1) To ensure coherent redevelopment of the town centre and avoid isolation of

smaller land parcels.

(2) To minimise the number of driveway crossings and car park entries along a

street.

#### Controls

(1) Amalgamation and subdivision is to facilitate the achievement of the

relevant development outcomes identified in Section 3.0 of this section.

(2) An applicant is to demonstrate to Council that, given the built form

provisions of this section, the exclusion of an adjacent / adjoining allotment

from their site will not adversely affect the development potential of that

allotment.
